project_type: React 18 SPA with Supabase backend (perfecity schema)
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom, setup in src/test-setup.ts. Store tests mock @/lib/supabase. Component tests use render/screen/fireEvent from @testing-library/react.
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: vitest run. 3. All 175+ tests should pass. New tests must also pass.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. NODE_OPTIONS must be unset before running vitest/tsc. No Docker needed. Supabase client uses env vars (not available at test time, mocked in tests).
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, no unused locals/params. Tests mock @/lib/supabase module. Components follow existing patterns: barrel exports via index.ts, __tests__/ subdirectories.
key_patterns: Zustand stores with separate State/Actions/Store types. fromTable() helper for Supabase queries. supabase.rpc() for RPC calls. Components use inline styles (no CSS framework). Store tests use vi.mock('@/lib/supabase') at top level. Component multi-file dirs use index.ts barrel. data-testid attributes for test selectors.
directory_structure: frontend/src/ contains: App.tsx (root), canvas/ (Konva layers), components/ (UI panels), hooks/ (empty), lib/ (supabase, autosave, coordinates), stores/ (Zustand: auth, project, canvas, sku, bom, publish), types/ (database.ts, canvas.ts, index.ts)
